name: Design Focus
body:
Choose any design of runic script. Any scripts you cast of that design are harder to resist.

Benefit: Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against scripts from the design of runic script you select.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new design of script.
